name: Tokyo DisneySea Hotel MiraCosta
description: The most extraordinary hotel at any Disney resort in the world — Tokyo DisneySea Hotel MiraCosta is built directly into the Mediterranean Harbour of Tokyo DisneySea, offering rooms that look directly onto the park lagoon, Mount Prometheus and the nightly spectacular. Guests can watch the DisneySea electrical parade from their hotel room window. The ultimate Disney hotel experience and one of the most coveted hotel rooms in Japan.

rooms.name: Harbour View Room
rooms.description: Spectacular room overlooking Mediterranean Harbour and Mount Prometheus.

rooms.name: Piazza View Room
rooms.description: Elegant room overlooking the Piazza Topolino and park entrance.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Magnificent suite with panoramic park views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Fantasy Springs Hotel
description: The newest and most magical Disney hotel at Tokyo DisneySea — Fantasy Springs Hotel opened in 2024 as part of the Fantasy Springs expansion, offering elaborately themed rooms inspired by the Frozen, Rapunzel and Tinker Bell worlds with direct access to the Fantasy Springs land and extraordinary Disney theming throughout. The most exciting new Disney hotel in Asia.

rooms.name: Frozen Kingdom Room
rooms.description: Beautifully Frozen-themed room with Elsa and Anna decor.

rooms.name: Rapunzel's Forest Room
rooms.description: Enchanting Rapunzel-themed room with elaborate tower decor.

rooms.name: Grand Suite
rooms.description: Magnificent themed suite with park views and breakfast included.

name: Tokyo Disney Ambassador Hotel
description: The classic flagship Disney hotel at Tokyo Disney Resort — the Ambassador Hotel is a beautifully appointed Art Deco styled resort hotel offering comfortable Disney-themed rooms, multiple restaurants, a pool and easy access to both Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea via the Resort Line monorail. One of the most established and beloved Disney hotels in Asia.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegant Art Deco Disney-themed room with free WiFi.

rooms.name: Character Room
rooms.description: Specially themed Disney character room with elaborate decor.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with Disney theming and complimentary breakfast.

name: Tokyo Disneyland Hotel
description: The grandest and most opulent Disney hotel in Asia — the Tokyo Disneyland Hotel is a magnificent Victorian-styled castle hotel located directly at the entrance of Tokyo Disneyland, offering the most elaborate Disney theming of any hotel in the resort with chandelier-lit lobbies, character dining and extraordinary park proximity.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Opulent Victorian-themed room with Disney decor and park views.

rooms.name: Castle View Room
rooms.description: Premium room with direct Cinderella Castle views and upgraded amenities.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Grand suite with castle and park views with character breakfast.
